dataType.description: Resolved data-type name, omitted when unset.

V3Concept.description: `Concepts/<name>.md` frontmatter — the human-editable business-concept format that replaced the `Config/business_concept*.json` triad. `name` is written on export and preferred on import (`parse_concept_files`, `services/sync/src/github_builders/import_parser.rs`) over the file's own basename, since the basename is sanitized to `[a-zA-Z0-9-_]` and can't carry a name like "Leverandør" intact; a hand-authored file with no `name:` key still falls back to its basename. `columns` links to `<table>.<column>` name paths (a literal `.` escaped as `\.`, mirroring `V3Diagram.folder`'s `\/`).

source.description: Omitted for a manual link; export writes `ruleBased` for a link a concept rule created.

columnUuid.description: Rename fallback when `path` no longer resolves on import; also written by export (and resolved first, ahead of `path`) when the path's table name is shared by more than one table and would otherwise be ambiguous.

V3ConceptColumnLink.description: A `columns[]` entry's object form — a bare string is shorthand for a plain `linked` entry with no exceptions.

V3ConceptRule.description: `uuid`/`businessConceptUuid` are always minted/injected on import, never authored, so they carry no slot here — same as `V3QualityRule`'s `uuid`.
